# Adding the logs bucket to knr-ops

> ⚠️ **One correction up front:** `s3.aws.upbound.io` is the **Crossplane** Upjet API group. The task says "ACK S3 CRDs", so I use the actual ACK groups: `s3.services.k8s.aws` and `iam.services.k8s.aws`. If your repo truly pins `s3.aws.upbound.io`, swap the `apiVersion`s accordingly — structure stays identical.

## Directory layout

```
infra/
├── s3/
│   ├── kustomization.yaml
│   ├── bucket-assets.yaml        # existing
│   └── logs/
│       ├── kustomization.yaml
│       ├── bucket.yaml
│       ├── bucket-policy.yaml
│       └── public-access-block.yaml
└── iam/
    └── logs-irsa/
        ├── kustomization.yaml
        ├── role.yaml
        ├── policy.yaml
        └── oidc-trust.enc.yaml    # SOPS-encrypted OIDC provider/audience

flux/
└── logs-bucket-kustomization.yaml
```

## 1. Bucket (base) — `infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  annotations:
    s3.services.k8s.aws/region: us-east-1   # overridden per overlay
spec:
  name: myapp-logs   # patched to myapp-logs-{env} per overlay
  versioning:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
        bucketKeyEnabled: false
  tagging:
    tagSet:
      - key: app
        value: myapp
      - key: component
        value: logs
      - key: managed-by
        value: knr-ops
```

### `infra/s3/logs/public-access-block.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  bucket:
    name: myapp-logs
  blockPublicAcls: true
  blockPublicPolicy: true
  ignorePublicAcls: true
  restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket-policy.yaml`

Forces TLS-in-transit only (denies insecure transport):

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: BucketPolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  bucket: myapp-logs
  policy: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Sid": "DenyInsecureTransport",
          "Effect": "Deny",
          "Principal": "*",
          "Action": "s3:*",
          "Resource": [
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs",
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs/*"
          ],
          "Condition": { "Bool": { "aws:SecureTransport": "false" } }
        }
      ]
    }
```

### `infra/s3/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - public-access-block.yaml
  - bucket-policy.yaml
```

## 2. IRSA role — `infra/iam/logs-irsa/`

### `policy.yaml` (least privilege, no wildcards)

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Sid": "ListBucket",
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs"
        },
        {
          "Sid": "ReadWriteObjects",
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject",
            "s3:AbortMultipartUpload", "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

### `oidc-trust.enc.yaml` (SOPS-encrypted trust doc)

The OIDC provider URL is per-cluster and treated as sensitive config; stored encrypted (excerpt — the `data` payload is `sops`-encrypted `ENC[...]`):

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-oidc-trust
type: Opaque
stringData:
  oidcProvider: ENC[AES256_GCM,data:tS9x...,iv:...]
  oidcAudience: ENC[AES256_GCM,data:tsa4...,iv:...]
  namespace: myapp
  serviceAccount: logs-writer
sops:
  kms:
    - arn: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/aaaa-bbbb-cccc
      created_at: "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z"
      enc: AQICA...
  mac: ENC[AES256_GCM,...]
  version: 3.8.1
```

### `role.yaml`

ACK's `Role` CR doesn't templatize the trust policy, so reconcile a `Role` whose trust is kept in sync via a small kustomize var or, idiomatically in ACK repos, the trust doc is written to match the overlay-patched provider. Simplest reliable pattern — patch the trust per overlay:

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [{
        "Effect": "Allow",
        "Principal": { "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE" },
        "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
        "Condition": {
          "StringEquals": {
            "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer",
            "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
          }
        }
      }]
    }
```

### `infra/iam/logs-irsa/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - policy.yaml
  - role.yaml
  - oidc-trust.enc.yaml
```

## 3. Overlays

### `overlays/dev/logs-patch.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  annotations:
    s3.services.k8s.aws/region: us-east-1
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
---
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  bucket:
    name: myapp-logs-dev
---
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: BucketPolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  bucket: myapp-logs-dev
  policy: |
    { "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [{ "Sid": "DenyInsecureTransport", "Effect": "Deny", "Principal": "*",
        "Action": "s3:*",
        "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev", "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"],
        "Condition": { "Bool": { "aws:SecureTransport": "false" } } }] }
---
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  policyDocument: |
    { "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        { "Sid": "ListBucket", "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev" },
        { "Sid": "ReadWriteObjects", "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject","s3:AbortMultipartUpload","s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*" } ] }
---
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-dev
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    { "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [{ "Effect": "Allow",
        "Principal": { "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVOIDCDEV" },
        "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
        "Condition": { "StringEquals": {
          "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVOIDCDEV:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer",
          "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVOIDCDEV:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com" } } }] }
```

Update `overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml` and `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml` (prod patch is identical in shape: `myapp-logs-prod`, region `us-west-2` if that's prod's region, prod OIDC provider ID, `myapp-logs-irsa-prod`):

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../infra/s3/logs
  - ../../infra/iam/logs-irsa
patches:
  - path: logs-patch.yaml
```

## 4. Separate Flux kustomization — `flux/logs-bucket-kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/dev            # promoted to ./overlays/prod on the prod branch
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops                 # matches the existing source in flux/kustomizations.yaml
  timeout: 2m
  decryption:
    provider: sops                # decrypts oidc-trust.enc.yaml
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
      namespace: default
```

## Notes on acceptance criteria

- ✅ Versioning, AES256, full public access block — enforced in base, both envs
- ✅ Least privilege — actions enumerated explicitly, resource ARNs scoped to the logs bucket only, no wildcards (even in dev)
- ✅ Secrets — only the OIDC trust details are sensitive; stored SOPS-encrypted and decrypted by Flux's `decryption.provider: sops`
- ✅ Env isolation — all env differences live in overlays; Flux path per environment means prod changes can't touch dev state
- ⚠️ Because prod policy is stricter in the spec's spirit, consider adding a `targetBucket`/KMS upgrade in prod overlay if you later switch from AES256 to KMS
